name: learn-kit
description: Create tiered learning materials, concise term cards, and concept deep dives, with optional NotebookLM multimedia.

interface.shortDescription: Tiered learning, term cards, and concept explanations
interface.longDescription: Generate source-grounded learning materials at foundation, structural, and challenge levels; explain terms and concepts; optionally create personal NotebookLM multimedia (requires Node.js 22+, uv 0.11.21+, Python 3.12 available to uv, and learn-kit NLM bridge 4.0.0 with connector 0.8.7; run nlm login when prompted).
defaultPrompt: Use $learn-kit:three-views to create three levels of learning material for a topic.
Use $learn-kit:glossary to explain an unfamiliar term briefly.
Use $learn-kit:concept to explain a concept with examples and boundaries.
